dedupe_keys.name: caltrans traffic census program state highway traffic volumes

description: The Caltrans Traffic Census Program publishes traffic counts for the California State Highway System, that is routes signed as Interstate, California State Route or United States Route. Counts are summarised annually into four categories: Annual Average Daily Traffic (AADT) for all vehicles, Annual Average Daily Truck Traffic, ramp volumes on state freeways by Caltrans district, and peak hour volume data giving the morning and evening peak periods as a percentage of AADT together with the traffic monitoring sites. Coverage is regional (California), for state highways only; counts for city and county streets must be sought from local agencies. The files are free and available to download as XLSX, with AADT and truck AADT for 2013 to 2024 (some years listed as not available), ramp volumes for 2016 to 2024 (2016 as PDF) and an explanation of the back and ahead leg counting convention. Caveats: values are annual averages at count locations, not continuous flows, and gaps exist for some years. The volumes support demand assignment, capacity planning, truck freight analysis and exposure weighting when highway links are closed by hazards. They complement the Caltrans Performance Measurement System (PeMS), which holds the continuous detector data.
